cards.title: Kube Shield
cards.description: Turnkey security for your kubernetes clusters. Automatically detect container images, scan for vulnerabilities, and explore results through an intuitive UI.

cards.title: Guido
cards.description: Your race engineer, on your phone. Guido turns a spare phone or tablet into a live race dashboard and a voice co-driver for sim racing: shift lights and tire temps at a glance, fuel strategy over push-to-talk, all local and zero-setup.

cards.title: FakeData
cards.description: Zero-config test data for your stack. Generate realistic datasets on demand with 80+ built-in generators, then pipe them to files, queues, or another process.

cards.title: DB Diff
cards.description: Know when your data drifts. Compare tables across two databases by checksumming: only digests cross the wire when the tables match, and a mismatch comes back as the primary keys that changed.

cards.title: Bookmarks
cards.description: Save anything, find everything. A dead-simple bookmark manager with nested tags and instant search: no link you ever saved will ever get forgotten again.

cards.title: Matto Bar
cards.description: All your subscription quotas in your menu bar. Monitor every AI provider at a glance: tokens, credits, API call volume, so you never hit limits unexpectedly and can optimize usage across providers.
